_comment: Spike 0a, HARDENED profile — the posture this toolkit would actually ship.
Every key beyond BASELINE closes a documented gap, and the spike's job is to
prove each one earns its place:
failIfUnavailable        — no sandbox, no run. Without it a missing bubblewrap
downgrades to a WARNING and Claude runs UNSANDBOXED.
allowUnsandboxedCommands — kills the dangerouslyDisableSandbox escape hatch the
model may reach for on its own when a command fails.
allowManagedDomainsOnly  — non-allowlisted domains are BLOCKED rather than
prompted. Unattended -p runs have nobody to prompt.
permissions.deny         — sandbox.network covers the Bash tool ONLY. WebFetch/
WebSearch are separate egress the allowlist never sees.
re-allow what we just denied. Consumer repos are
untrusted input; their settings file is too.
See docs/adr/0001 addendum for the outcome.
